blind.table_distance_name: open prison cell door with bars
blind.description: A heavy dark-iron jail cell wall section featuring an open barred door set within a thick rectangular barred frame. The frame consists of heavy square corner posts, top and bottom crossbeams, and vertical bars. The door itself is composed of vertical iron bars and horizontal reinforcement bands with large rounded rivets, mounted on heavy cylindrical barrel hinges and swung open into the room. Surfaces are solid, continuous, and textured with weathered, slightly pitted dark cast iron with subtle metallic highlights. No floating or disconnected parts, and the underside rests flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: A straight thick horizontal bar (the frame) with square post ends, with a thinner diagonal bar extending outward at approximately a 45-degree angle representing the open door leaf.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 6 feet tall (slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4.5 to 5 feet wide along the frame.
